description: A master clock giving bar, beat, eighth and sixteenth pulses at a tempo set in beats per minute

params.text: Sets the tempo, 30 to 300 beats per minute
Sets the upper figure of the time signature, 2 to 15, which is how many beats make a bar
Sets the lower figure of the time signature: 2, 4, 8 or 16, the note value that takes one beat
Sends the clock back to the start of the bar
Starts and stops the clock; every output stays at 0V while it is stopped

inputs.text: A trigger here starts or stops the clock
A trigger here sends the clock back to the start of the bar

outputs.text: A 10V pulse on each eighth note
A 10V pulse on each sixteenth note
A 10V pulse at the start of each bar
A 10ms 10V pulse each time the clock is sent back to the start of the bar
A 10ms 10V pulse each time the clock is started or stopped

notes: The clock is running as soon as the module is added to the rack, and whether it is running is saved with the patch.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
